results.title: The Best Movies to See in Regal's Deep Cuts Series
results.description: Regal's Deep Cuts series offers a chance to see cult classics and overlooked gems on the big screen. Here are 15 standout titles, including 'Oldboy,' 'Under the Skin,' and 'The World's End,' that deserve a theatrical re-viewing.

results.title: Chrishell Stause Announces Split from G Flip: 'I Will Always Love G'
results.description: Chrishell Stause reveals her separation from G Flip, expressing deep love and respect despite the breakup. The couple's relationship, which followed Stause's split from Jason Oppenheim, was highlighted on Selling Sunset before concluding. Stause discusses the challenges of moving forward while maintaining positive feelings for G Flip.

results.title: Sara Foster Reveals She's Not Dating After Two‑Year Split, Still Lives With Ex
results.description: The former relationship and living situation of Sara Foster are laid out as she speaks on Kristin Cavallari's "Let's Be Honest" podcast, revealing that for two years after the breakup with Tommy Haas she has not dated anyone, remains in their shared home, and prefers to only date people she knows well. The conversation also briefly covers her earlier comment that her relationships always started as friendships.
